tool.name: Biomni: Predict Protein Disorder Regions
tool.description: Predicts intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) in a protein sequence using IUPred2A.

param.name: protein_sequence
param.label: Protein Sequence
param.help: The amino acid sequence of the protein to analyze

param.name: threshold
param.label: Threshold
param.help: The disorder score threshold above which a residue is considered disordered (default: 0.5)

param.name: output_file
param.label: Output File
param.help: Filename to save the per-residue disorder scores (default: 'disorder_prediction_results.csv')

tool.help:
**Biomni: Predict Protein Disorder Regions**
Predicts intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) in a protein sequence using IUPred2A.
Parameters ---------- protein_sequence : str The amino acid sequence of the protein to analyze threshold : float, optional The disorder score threshold above which a residue is considered disordered (default: 0.5) output_file : str, optional Filename to save the per-residue disorder scores (default: 'disorder_prediction_results.csv')
Returns ------- str A research log summarizing the prediction process and results
**Domain**: biophysics **Function**: predict_protein_disorder_regions
